title: [Bug][Model Runner V2]: [Bug] GLM-5.2 shows low aa_lcr accuracy and large TPOT fluctuations on B300
author: chaunceyjiang

comments.author: Saurav-Gupta-9741
comments.body:
Hi @chaunceyjiang Sir,

Thank you for reporting this! I am very interested in taking this issue on and diving into the V2 Model Runner logic to fix these latency spikes and accuracy drops for GLM-5.2.

Proposed Debugging Strategy: My initial thought is that this could be a state leakage or stale data issue during the CUDA Graph capture, or potentially an issue with how the Key-Value (KV) cache pointers/attention metadata are being passed to the attention backend during V2's multi-step execution. I plan to first isolate the issue by testing with enforce_eager=True to determine if it is strictly tied to the CUDA graph capture, and then trace the tensor outputs layer-by-layer between V1 and V2 to find where they diverge.

Quick Question on Hardware: I will be doing my debugging and reproduction on an NVIDIA A30 (Ampere) GPU cluster. Since you mentioned your tests were conducted on a B300, do you suspect this might be a hardware/architecture-specific Triton kernel bug? Or do you believe this is a broader V2 logic/graph capture issue that I will be able to successfully reproduce and fix on my Ampere setup?

If you believe the A30 will be sufficient to reproduce the bug, I would love to officially pick this up and get started! Looking forward to your response.

comments.author: WoosukKwon
comments.body: @chaunceyjiang My claude proposed #47381 and two others. Can you please give it a try?
